meta.scope: Yemen Batch 1 — Phase 0/1 foundations under locked expanded node definition. Central Statistical Office, population, national accounts, CPI, Central Bank of Yemen institutional core, BOP. Population ~43 million. Data environment severely constrained by conflict and dual institutions.

candidates.title: Central Statistical Office (Yemen) institutional core
candidates.description: Primary national statistical office. Conflict has severely limited compilation capacity; extensive external capacity support is required for national accounts and external statistics. Data continuity and coverage are highly constrained.
candidates.notes: Foundational institutional node under severe capacity constraints.

candidates.title: Population estimates
candidates.description: Population estimates. Population is approximately 43 million; the age structure is very young and conflict-related displacement is large-scale.

candidates.title: National Accounts of Yemen (GDP)
candidates.description: National accounts and GDP estimates. The economy has contracted sharply under prolonged conflict; oil production is a fraction of pre-war levels and non-oil activity is severely disrupted.
candidates.notes: Primary macroeconomic output node under severe conflict constraints.

candidates.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
candidates.description: CPI and inflation rates. Inflation has been elevated and highly volatile under exchange-rate collapse, supply disruptions and dual-currency conditions.
candidates.notes: Core high-frequency price node under elevated-inflation and dual-rate conditions.

candidates.title: Central Bank of Yemen institutional and reporting core
candidates.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, foreign-exchange management and key macro-financial statistics where published. Dual institutional realities and limited reserves constrain operations.
candidates.notes: Central-bank institutional counterpart under dual and constrained conditions.

candidates.title: Balance of Payments and external accounts
candidates.description: BOP and external-sector statistics. Oil exports have collapsed; remittances, humanitarian inflows and limited formal trade dominate; reserves are critically low.
candidates.notes: External-accounts node under severe constraint and large informal/humanitarian flows.

candidates.title: Yemen foundational statistical-system meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from CSO and CBY sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding the CSO institutional core, population, national accounts, CPI, CBY institutional role and BOP into the opening foundation layer for Yemeni research.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
candidates.notes: Opening integrating node. Extreme conflict, dual institutions and data gaps should be carried forward in all subsequent batches.
